bonus.q: Gælder Stayman og overføringer, når modparten melder ind over makkers 1NT?
bonus.why: Stayman og transfers bortfalder efter en indmelding. Ny farve billigst er ønske om at spille, spring er krav, og overmelding i fjendens farve søger hold.

bonus.q: Do Stayman and transfers apply when the opponents overcall partner's 1NT?
bonus.why: Stayman and transfers are off after an overcall. A new suit at the cheapest level is to play, a jump is forcing, and a cue-bid in the opponents' suit asks for a stopper.
